The spin projection onto a fixed axis $z$ is not yet the helicity: one needs to know
in which direction the particle was flying. Let us compare two photon emission directions.


::: {.nh-box tone="warning" size="md" align="center" weight="bold"}

The same neutrino helicity allows both photon helicities.
One needs to select photons by their direction relative to the recoil $B^*$.

:::
